## ✅ Contribution & Quality Checklist

- [ ] **Test Pairing**: Feature (`feat:`) or Bugfix (`fix:`) is committed together with its tests in the same commit.
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: Commit message(s) adhere to `feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, `refactor(...)`, etc.
- [ ] **Linting & Formatting**: Code passes `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check`.
- [ ] **Typecheck**: `npm run typecheck` passes without errors.
- [ ] **Production Build**: `npm run build` succeeds.
